subject: Charged twice this month
body: Hi, I just checked my statement and I was billed 49.00 EUR twice on the 1st. I only have one subscription. Please refund the duplicate.

subject: Cannot log in after password reset
body: I reset my password like the email said and now it says account locked. I have a client demo in 20 minutes. This is really bad timing.

subject: Love the new dashboard
body: Just wanted to say the new analytics dashboard is excellent. The export button saved me an hour today. Keep it up!

subject: Where is my order??
body: Order #88213 was supposed to arrive last Tuesday. Tracking has not moved in six days. Nobody answers. This is the third time I am writing. Absolutely unacceptable.

subject: Question about invoice format
body: Our finance team needs the VAT number printed on the PDF invoice. Is that configurable somewhere in settings?

subject: API returning 500 on bulk endpoint
body: Since this morning POST /v2/bulk returns 500 for payloads over ~200 records. Smaller batches work. Our nightly sync is failing. Request id 7f3a91.

subject: Cancel my account
body: I want to cancel. The product is fine but we are shutting down the project. How do I export my data before the account closes?

subject: Re: Re: Re: still broken
body: Your agent told me it was fixed. It is not fixed. I have now wasted four hours on this. If this is not resolved today we are moving to a competitor and I will be disputing the charge.

subject: Call transcript: upgrade question
body: Customer asked whether the Pro plan includes SSO and how seat pricing works above 50 users. Wants a written answer to share internally.

subject: URGENT: production down
body: All webhook deliveries stopped at 17:52 UTC. We have 12k events queued. Status page says operational which is clearly wrong. Need someone on this now.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body: Any plans for a dark theme? Our team works late and the white UI is rough on the eyes. Not urgent, just a nice to have.

subject: Refund request outside policy window
body: I bought the annual plan 45 days ago and barely used it. I know your policy says 30 days but I am hoping you can make an exception.

subject: Wrong item delivered
body: I ordered the 2m cable and received a 0.5m one. Order #88450. Happy to send it back, just need a label and the right one shipped.

subject: Security: possible unauthorized access
body: I see three logins from an IP in another country in my audit log last night. I did not do those. I have changed my password but please check what was accessed.

subject: Billing page errors when I click upgrade
body: Clicking Upgrade throws a red error toast saying 'payment profile missing'. I do have a card on file. Tried two browsers.

subject: Data processing agreement
body: Our legal team needs a signed DPA before we can roll out to the EU org. Who should I send the document to, and do you have a standard one?

subject: App crashes on upload, losing work
body: Every time I upload a file over 40MB the tab freezes and I lose everything I typed. Happened three times today. I am honestly about to give up on this.
